question: should the sister products freecurrencyapi.com and fxapi.com of the same company as currencyapi.com get records?
why: The currencyapi.com pricing page names freecurrencyapi.com (daily rates for 33 major currencies, 1,000 requests a month) and fxapi (300 free requests a month) as sister products. They were outside the list of 8 for this unit and were not read.
